name: Sofie Linnea Bollen
bio: Sofie is a Master's student in Biotechnology at University of Copenhagen, complemented by a semester of study at Wageningen University & Research. Her thesis project investigates the potential PFAS-degrading capabilities of the cyanobacterium Microcystis aeruginosa, based on genomic evidence of positive selection for PFAS degradation and its potential links to photosynthetic overcompensation and stress-coping mechanisms. In parallel, her project aims to identify proteins interacting with perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) through photocatalyst-mediated proximity labelling.
